setting.help: Claude Desktop, ChatGPT and other assistants that speak MCP can use the tools of Nudge, as the person whose key they hold: with that person's rights, record rules and companies. Each person of the group External Assistant makes a key of their own. Everything they do is kept in What Nudge Did.

div.div: The tools for developers are never offered. A change is never made at once: the assistant gets a token, the person is asked in Odoo (Nudge, Assistant Approvals) and sees what will change, and the assistant can confirm with the token only after the person has approved it there.

setting.help: Changes from assistants also need the group Agent User for the person and Agent Mode above. Set for the company in use.

setting.invisible: not nudge_mcp_enabled or nudge_mcp_exposure != 'write' or not nudge_mcp_allow_writes
setting.help: Unsafe: the assistant would confirm what it prepared without asking the person. Post, validate, pay, confirm orders and changes to users and rights still wait for the person.
With Private Mode on, assistants are refused unless they run on your own server.
